create: CREATE TABLE `cloud_product_data` (`productId` TEXT NOT NULL, `configVersion` INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(`productId`))

CREATE TABLE `cloud_request_data` (`productId` TEXT NOT NULL, `configCode` TEXT NOT NULL, `systemCondition` TEXT NOT NULL, `customParams` TEXT NOT NULL, `productVersion` INTEGER NOT NULL, `configVersion` INTEGER NOT NULL, `extraParams` TEXT NOT NULL, `configMaxVersion` INTEGER NOT NULL, `recentActiveTime` INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY(`productId`, `configCode`, `systemCondition`, `customParams`))

CREATE TABLE `config_file_data` (`index` INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT NOT NULL, `productId` TEXT NOT NULL, `configCode` TEXT NOT NULL, `systemCondition` TEXT, `customParams` TEXT, `configVersion` INTEGER NOT NULL, `filePath` TEXT NOT NULL, `fileType` INTEGER NOT NULL, `productVersion` INTEGER NOT NULL, `extraParams` TEXT NOT NULL, `content` BLOB, `configMaxVersion` INTEGER NOT NULL, `accessTime` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)

CREATE TABLE `config_file_download` (`productId` TEXT NOT NULL, `configCode` TEXT NOT NULL, `systemCondition` TEXT NOT NULL, `customParams` TEXT NOT NULL, `configVersion` INTEGER NOT NULL, `productVersion` INTEGER NOT NULL, `fileUrl` TEXT NOT NULL, `fileType` INTEGER NOT NULL, `failCount` INTEGER NOT NULL, `status` INTEGER NOT NULL, `extraParams` TEXT NOT NULL, `content` BLOB, `configMaxVersion` INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(`productId`, `configCode`, `systemCondition`, `customParams`))
CREATE TABLE room_master_table (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,identity_hash TEXT)
